description: This file defines the AuthenticationService interface, which specifies a method for authenticating a user based on SASL exchange information. It provides method documentation describing how authentication requests are structured for different mechanisms and how to handle success or failure results.

classes.name: AuthenticationService
classes.description: Interface for verifying credentials provided by clients during SASL authentication exchanges.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication based on provided JSON authentication data. Invokes the handler with success containing the HonoUser upon success, or a failure with an error exception.
